d:
I took LOT Polish Airlines from Berlin to Warsaw and Warsaw to Delhi while returning from Germany to India in October 2023. My flight was delayed by more than 4 hours, making my total layover at Warsaw airport over 6 hours. Only after demanding was I compensated for meals, but after that, a bad experience awaited me on my connecting flight to Delhi. The maintenance and cabin crew failed to properly perform their duties, making my 8-hour flight unpleasant. I am still in touch with the Airline through emails, but they are quite reluctant to compensate.
